name: D.P.S.
source:
D.P.S. is a collection of three short scenarios, which are unrelated to each other story-wise and can be played separately. Those scenarios are presented as cartridges played on a fictional console named Dream Program System. Each scenario allows the player to choose between two different protagonists, or two different personalities for the protagonist. All of the scenarios feature nudity and/or sexual situations.

The scenarios in this game include:
1. A medieval fantasy tale entitled Princess Fantasy, in which the player controls a knight who accompanies a princess on a journey. Depending on the personality choice, the knight can either be brave and compassionate, or cynically take advantage of the helpless girl.

2. A typical "naughty doctor" story, in which the player - as either male or female school doctor - has to "examine" young and pretty female patients, trying not to scare them away by employing too direct methods.

3. An encounter between a famous female pop idol and her fan (also female), which leads to a bizarre sexual experience. The player can choose to control the events from the point of view of either the star or the fan.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/dps-dream-program-system]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《D.P.S.》由三段彼此毫无关联、可以单独游玩的短篇剧情组成。这些剧情被包装成虚构主机“梦幻程序系统”上的三张游戏卡带。每段剧情都允许玩家在两名不同主角之间作出选择，或为同一主角选择两种不同性格。所有剧情均含有裸体和／或性情境。

本作收录以下剧情：
1.《公主幻想》是一篇中世纪奇幻故事。玩家扮演陪伴公主踏上旅途的骑士。根据所选性格，骑士既可以勇敢而富有同情心，也可以冷酷地趁机占无助少女的便宜。

2.一段典型的“下流医生”故事。玩家可以扮演男校医或女校医，为年轻貌美的女患者进行“检查”，同时还得避免手段过于直接，把她们吓跑。

3.一名著名女偶像与她的女性粉丝相遇，继而经历一场怪诞的性体验。玩家可以选择从偶像或粉丝的视角掌控事件。
